lines.en: I walk through the woods in red armor.
My horn is thicker than my legs.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，甲片互相摩擦
lines.en: Each step grinds my plates together.
Three meters tall, and slow.

lines.zh: 我沿着同一条路来回走
lines.en: I walk the same path back and forth.

lines.zh: 我的红壳上有白色纹路
lines.en: White markings cross my red shell.

lines.zh: 我从树下走过，差点顶到枝
lines.en: I pass under a branch and nearly catch it.
My wings murmur under the shell.
I do not chase; I simply walk over.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上慢慢地移
lines.en: My shadow creeps across the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不想磕到角
lines.en: I go around stones so my horn does not knock.

lines.zh: 我朝虫声最密的方向走
lines.en: I head where the insects are loudest.

lines.zh: 我站着，红甲在树影里发暗
lines.en: I stand, red shell dark in the shade.
A strip of bark is stuck in that crack.

lines.zh: 我在听树皮底下的动静
lines.en: I listen to what moves under the bark.

lines.zh: 我的口器在动，什么也没吃
lines.en: My mouthparts work, eating nothing.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近，这里是我的
lines.en: I am near my anchor; this is mine.
My shell is bright in the light.
I need not move much.

lines.zh: 这片林子的虫我都认得
lines.en: I know every insect in this wood.

lines.zh: 我把前腿换了一下重心
lines.en: I shift weight to another foreleg.
An insect on the tree; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我只嗡一下翅膀
lines.en: I do not cry out; I only hum my wings.

lines.zh: 我的红壳上落了一层薄灰
lines.en: A thin dust settles on my red shell.
I wait for night; more insects then.
I lower my horn to rest.

lines.zh: 我抬起角，对着你的方向
lines.en: I raise my horn toward you.

lines.zh: 我的角比你的头顶高得多
lines.en: My horn rides far above your head.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里有很多个你
lines.en: My compound eyes hold many of you.
I will not start it, but do not come close.
My anchor is here.

lines.zh: 我的甲很硬，你该看得出来
lines.en: My shell is hard; you can likely tell.
I move a leg first.
There are no insects in your smell.
My wings opened half an inch.
You raise a hand and my horn drops.
If you retreat, I will not follow.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段树下阴影
lines.en: A stretch of tree shadow lies between us.
I track every move your hands make.
My horn tip halts at your collarbone.
This wood is not yours.
I have your height noted.
I step back, my plates clattering.

lines.zh: 这一下在我红甲上开了口
lines.en: That opened a seam in my red shell.

lines.zh: 我叫不出来，只嗡了一下翅
lines.en: I cannot cry out; my wings hum once.
All six of my legs are shaking.
I turn my body sideways.
The force I had gathered is scattered.
My horn is slightly off.

lines.zh: 这一击的力量我存下了
lines.en: I have stored the force of that blow.
My legs still carry this shell.
You will need more than that.
There is the smell of insects.
This will do; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 你手上那只是死的，我也吃
lines.en: The one in your hand is dead; I eat it anyway.
I lower my head and come closer slowly.
I could clear a whole bush in one bite.
Set it down and I will come.
I eat insects, nothing else.
I press my mouthparts to the leaf.
I am hungry, but I will not snatch.
Step behind a tree and I'll eat.
That bite was gentle.
Let me look for more.
You charge; my feet do not move.
The red shell answers with a dull boom.
That shook leaves from the tree.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地面陷了一块
lines.en: I give half a step, and the ground dips.
My horn veered.
I turn my body aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，声音传得很远
lines.en: We collide; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被挤压了一下
lines.en: One wing was squeezed.
Roots snap under my feet.
Hit me again and the horn comes out.

lines.zh: 同一片林子里，偶尔会遇到
lines.en: In the same wood, we sometimes meet.
Its blue is brighter than my red.
We do not fight; there are insects enough.
A touch of horns is recognition.
We keep these trees together.
Two of us, and the trees feel crowded.
Our shells sound different.
It came to this wood before me.
We rarely meet our own kind.
I know which tree it settles by.
My mouthparts take hold of it.
Harder than my plates, this.
I flip it with my horn.
I wedge it into a root's gap.
It slips from between my mouthparts.
I am not handy at carrying.
I cannot eat this.
I push it to the edge of the wood.
Two chews and it was gone.

lines.zh: 我叼着它走了两步就松口
lines.en: I carry it two steps and let go.
Something is behind the tree.
I raise my horn.
This range favors a ranged strike.
I gather one charge first.
It is not tall, but I am careful.
My shell blocks the light.
Everything under these roots is mine.
It is not looking at me.
I have started moving my legs.
I counted two of its steps.
I have this shot planned.
The horn reaches it first.
I advance steadily.
It circles the tree; so do I.
My horn stays on it.
My wings begin to sound.
It retreats; my legs follow.
I wait for its flank.
The distance has closed exactly.
You are behind me; not too close.

lines.zh: 我每一步都陷进落叶里
lines.en: Each step sinks into the leaf litter.
Its breathing has grown heavy.
I plant myself and hold a charge.
I lower the horn further.
I charge, horn first.

lines.zh: 这一下带着三米的重量
lines.en: That carried three meters of weight.
A foreleg comes down and the ground caves.
It is shoved far back.
My shell slams in as well.
I step back to gather force again.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在树上，树断了
lines.en: That hit a tree, and the tree broke.
The horn is aimed at you again.
It blocks, and its arms shake.
Eight parts of my force is enough.
I chew at the air.
I brace and return to position.

lines.zh: 我从林间站起来，红甲发暗
lines.en: I rise in the wood, red shell dark.

lines.zh: 这一片树高虫多，我留下
lines.en: Tall trees, many insects; I stay.

lines.zh: 我先撞倒一棵小树，清地方
lines.en: I knock down a sapling to clear room.
My horn comes out of the tree shadow first.

lines.zh: 我从数据里成形，落在草地上
lines.en: I form from data onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我落地时，落叶全被压开
lines.en: When I land, the leaves are pressed aside.

lines.zh: 我站在锚点上，慢慢转身
lines.en: I stand at my anchor and turn slowly.
My red stands out against the green.
I fold my wings under the shell.

lines.zh: 这个林子够大，藏得下我
lines.en: This wood is big enough to hide me.
I look up at the canopy light.
I walk toward the insect noise.
Fire bakes my red shell darker.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸裂一块地
lines.en: I fall from height and split the ground.
Water in my seams; I sink a little.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的甲掀开一角
lines.en: The blast lifts a corner of my shell.
A shot lands in my shell's seam.
That force presses my horn down.
Too few insects; I stay hungry.
Lightning hits my horn and my shell lights up.
Not even roots below.
